title: The feedback loop, one stop at a time
summary: How a comment in the browser becomes a change in the plan — with no agent-specific API anywhere. Press Tour.

nodes.label: 1 · You read the plan
nodes.detail: The page shows the phase rail and every task. It live-updates while the agent works.

nodes.label: 2 · Comment on a task
nodes.detail: Hover a task → **Comment**. Or hit **Request changes** / **Approve** on the plan or spec.

nodes.label: 3 · FB-004 appended
nodes.detail:
```
### FB-004 · open · comment
- **Target:** plan › Phase 2 › Port reuse
- **When:** 2026-10-07 14:02

Can we pick a random free port instead?
```

nodes.label: 4 · Agent notices
nodes.detail: Either you say *“check feedback”*, or the skill checks `feedback.md` at fixed points: before approval questions, at every phase checkpoint, and at review time.

nodes.label: 5 · Agent acts
nodes.detail: Edits `spec.md` / `plan.md` as needed — the normal Conductor rules still apply (tech-stack changes documented first, etc.).

nodes.label: 6 · Reply & resolve
nodes.detail: Flips the heading to `resolved` and adds a `> **Agent:**` reply line under the item.

nodes.label: 7 · Page updates
nodes.detail: Within ~2 s the plan shows the change and the feedback item shows the reply. Loop closed.
